scene: The opened kimchi jar reveals glowing travel passes to faraway districts.
picture: Flat side view. Along a wide timber sky-dock, a maglev dragon train sits on the left platform. The young Chinese woman in red bomber jacket and white roller skates stands beside three opened clay jars left of centre. A sleek pink bullet train rests centre, while a solar-sail junk floats moored on the far right.
shown: a sleek maglev dragon train waiting open-doored on the left rail platform
a polished pink bullet train idling quietly at the centre station gate
a golden solar-sail junk moored at the wooden dock on the far right
